daylight_boundary_rules.authoring_method: Julian calendar date -> astronomical Julian Day -> NOAA/Meeus solar coordinates at historical epoch -> local mean solar time

exact_time_representation.boundary_unit: whole minute offset from local midnight
exact_time_representation.authoring_rounding: nearest whole minute once, floor(value + 0.5), then frozen

local_offset_rule.utc_mapping: not authored and not required for the sole gameplay clock

daypart_rule.night_before_dawn: local midnight to stored civil_dawn boundary
daypart_rule.civil_dawn: stored civil_dawn boundary to stored sunrise boundary
daypart_rule.daylight: stored sunrise boundary to stored sunset boundary
daypart_rule.civil_dusk: stored sunset boundary to stored civil_dusk boundary
daypart_rule.night_after_dusk: stored civil_dusk boundary to next local midnight
daypart_rule.boundary_semantics: left-closed/right-open except the next exact boundary batch owns the transition

payload.historical_calendar_scope_note: Julian day/month/leap projection with a project common-era year and January-1 epoch convention; it does not assert the locally used medieval era name, feast calendar or social year-start convention.
